sources.title: Alignment Collapse Under KV Cache Quantization: Diagnosis and Mitigation
sources.snippet: Abstract Key-value (KV) cache quantization is widely used to reduce Large Language Model (LLM) inference memory, yet existing evaluations solely focus on measuring perplexity and accuracy without assessing the safety impact. In this study, we explore alignment preservation under KV cache quantization.
